headline: Pakistan government approves new automobile policy
summary: The Pakistani government has approved a new automobile policy aimed at increasing competition, promoting electric vehicle manufacturing, and reducing reliance on imported petroleum products.
why: Automotive policy changes significantly impact the industrial sector and trade balance of developing economies.

impacts.name: Automotive
impacts.why: Policy shifts towards EVs and competition will restructure the local automotive market.
